name: Watermelon Basil Margarita
desc: Watermelon juice and gently muddled basil over blanco tequila

ingredients.raw: 1 pinch flaky salt or Tajin for the rim
ingredients.item: flaky salt or Tajin for the rim

steps: Rim the glass: Run a lime wedge around the rim of a rocks glass and dip in 1 pinch flaky salt or Tajin for the rim. Fill with fresh ice and set aside.
Muddle the basil: Add 4 fresh basil leaves to a shaker and gently muddle just enough to release the oils. Don't shred them or it turns bitter.

Build and shake: Add 2 fluid ounces blanco tequila, 2 fluid ounces watermelon juice, 3/4 fluid ounce fresh lime juice, 1/2 fluid ounce Cointreau, and 1/2 fluid ounce simple syrup to the shaker. Fill with ice and shake hard for about 15 seconds  until well chilled.
Strain and serve: Double strain over the fresh ice in your prepared glass. Garnish with a basil sprig or a small watermelon wedge.
